title: FunctionCatalogue
description: The published function catalogue (ADR-0025, ADR-0026): every standard function, keyed by its id. Adding a member is a schema change.

id.description: A function, family, input or param name: camelCase, at most 64 characters.

catalogueEntry.title: CatalogueEntry
catalogueEntry.description: One standard function. Its inputs and params are in signature order; a function without inputs or params leaves the member out.

generating.description: Present on a queue function whose result is a generating block, one value that every occurrence of the target field under every parent occurrence takes, as a constant's (ADR-0006, F-46); absent on every other function.

generatingOverSingleValue.description: Present on a queue function of one input whose call over a single value, a constant's or another single-value result, is a generating block, as PO keeps that result in constant form (ADR-0006, F-51); over a queue its result is a queue. Absent on every other function, and never beside generating.

portable.description: Whether the function's export runs on any conforming XSLT 3.0 processor.

stringParam.title: StringParam
stringParam.description: A string param: it takes its values only, the patterns of its syntax only, or any string when it has neither.

syntax.description: The Java/SAP pattern syntax the param is written in, which lowering checks through the formatting core (ADR-0003, ADR-0026): numberPattern is a java.text.DecimalFormat pattern, datePattern a java.text.SimpleDateFormat pattern.

default.$comment: Not in $defs: ui gen:types bundles this schema and the model schema into one namespace, where table is the model schema's.
default.title: TableDefault
default.description: A table of strings: its keys are source values, so it is the one open object.

fidelity.description: How the function relates to SAP PO/CPI behaviour (ADR-0026).

assumedFidelity.title: AssumedFidelity
assumedFidelity.description: An assumed reading, while one of the function's corpus cases is assumed.

deviationFidelity.title: DeviationFidelity
deviationFidelity.description: A documented difference from SAP PO/CPI behaviour.
